title: RTpipeline: Automated Radiotherapy DICOM Processing Pipeline
description: RTpipeline turns raw radiotherapy DICOM exports into analysis-ready cohort tables: validated patient courses, standardized structures from TotalSegmentator, local nnU-Net models and the RTsegmentator portal, dose-volume histogram metrics, PyRadiomics features with NTCV perturbation robustness, multimodal biomarkers and quality-control reports.
